_comment: Single source of truth for CI build-runner topology, per docker architecture. type=local → build natively on the GHA runner (no remote builder / no QEMU); type=ssh → dispatch to runners.<arch>.host running builder_image. runs_on is the GitHub Actions runner label a job targeting this arch must use. Consumed via 1_configs/dist/build-workflows.json (.runners), emitted by 1_configs/src/engine/derive-build-workflows.ts.
